catalog.digestFormat: JSON sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=true, ASCII bytes

semantics.blocked: Unverified as this complete catalog variant, or missing the stated prerequisite; not necessarily a product defect.
semantics.passed: Requires direct per-variant execution evidence covering the full expected behavior; related tests alone do not qualify.
semantics.not_applicable: Outside the declared operation contract with an explicit rationale; unsupported-request handling remains separately testable.
semantics.executionEvidence: Evidence of this entire catalog variant, not a nearby unit test or historical scenario.

unit.scope: Windows Python 3.12 synthetic task regression; not a catalog campaign or live user journey.

continuationLive.scopeWarning: Targeted working-tree live evidence in one nonproduction scope, not an exact-commit rerun, exhaustive catalog execution or whole-batch UI inspection. Retained test destinations were explicitly authorized; that consent is not reusable.

historicalLive.scope: Single nonproduction environment and selected reference set; no all-country/release claim.
historicalLive.scopeWarning: Historical targeted evidence; not promoted to a catalog pass or a fresh exact-commit live run.

PROMPT_TRANSCRIPT.reason: No complete catalog-ID-bound agent transcript proves routing, all follow-up questions/answers and the expected stopping rule.
PROMPT_TRANSCRIPT.nextAction: Run this variant through the Implementation Router and task skill; retain the unchanged prompt, follow-ups, final classification and absence/presence of the expected candidate.

FIELD_MATRIX.reason: Aggregate unit results are available, but no catalog-ID-bound field fixture and full assertion result were verified for this individual variant.
FIELD_MATRIX.nextAction: Execute the exact named field/identity variant with a compatible baseline and record normalization, candidate or rejection, plus every expected assertion.

RESOLVER_MATRIX.reason: No catalog-ID-bound authoritative zero/one/many-match resolver evidence was verified for this variant; task exports do not prove exhaustive reference domains.
RESOLVER_MATRIX.nextAction: Resolve the listed task-owned prerequisite from authorized FSM evidence; record exact match-count outcomes. If authority remains unavailable, retain the blocker rather than inventing a direct API/DB route.

STATUS_CAMPAIGN_FIXTURE.reason: Status-update/rollback unit coverage exists, but the catalog campaign fixture is still conditional and its complete per-variant execution evidence is absent.
STATUS_CAMPAIGN_FIXTURE.nextAction: Register the exact-key A/I fixture and execute this variant. A live rollback requires a successful forward import, separately governed reverse candidate, fresh exports and reconciliation.

CREATE_RETENTION.reason: The catalog live-create variant has no declared supported removal path or candidate-specific governed retained-state policy. Historical retained-state approvals do not authorize another run.
CREATE_RETENTION.nextAction: Obtain a supported cleanup declaration or explicit retained-state authorization for the exact scenario, then execute the normal task route and retain process results plus fresh-export reconciliation.

OWNER_GATES.reason: No complete campaign-owner evidence binds this variant's confirmation/approval invalidation, process state, or warning policy to an immutable design/candidate.
OWNER_GATES.nextAction: Exercise the relevant Run Book/Data Loader or tester gate with controlled fixtures; record prior and changed fingerprints, process identity and expected no-resubmit/no-handoff outcome.

CATALOG_EXECUTION.reason: Related unit tests are supporting evidence only; the complete catalog variant was not separately executed and its required evidence was not bound to its ID.
CATALOG_EXECUTION.nextAction: Execute this exact catalog variant and retain every required artifact and assertion. Do not promote related synthetic tests to live or conversation-level evidence.

REPORT_RENDER.reason: The existing historical page is not proof of this catalog report-rendering variant's complete acceptance checks.
REPORT_RENDER.nextAction: Render the full campaign from actual run records and validate inventory, prompts, follow-ups, artifact references and dispositions. Publish only under separately authorized classification/destination.

NO_EFFECTIVE_DATE.reason: This generic variant expects valid/invalid effective-date chronology, but the reviewed two-BO CSV contract exposes no supported scheduled end-date operation.
NO_EFFECTIVE_DATE.nextAction: Keep this positive chronology variant not applicable to the declared release scope. Continue testing end-date request clarification under the lifecycle negative cases; never substitute immediate inactivation silently.
